g.text: 1. INSTRUMENT SYMBOLS AND IDENTIFICATION PER ISA-5.1. EQUIPMENT OUTLINES AFTER ISO 10628.
2. PUMPS A AND B RUN AS DUTY, C AS STANDBY. MOTORS 3.6 MW, 6.6 kV, VSD ON PUMP A.
3. LEAK DETECTION BY REAL-TIME TRANSIENT MODEL AND MASS BALANCE PER API 1130.
5. ILLUSTRATIVE DRAWING. NOT FOR DESIGN, OPERATION OR CONSTRUCTION.
PLAN 52 SEAL POTS ON ALL PUMPS
CRUDE OIL TRUNK PIPELINE · PUMP STATION 3
L-3500 PIPELINE SEGMENT PS3 → PS4 · 186 km · 28" · API 5L X65
